subject: english
stem:
A class tried standing for short parts of lessons. Some students felt more awake, while others found it hard to write.
Which option is neither too narrow nor too broad?
options: All students should stand through every lesson
Standing made writing easy for everyone
Standing during lessons had mixed effects for the class

optionRationales.reason: All students should stand through every lesson：some/others 的結果不支持普遍規定。
Standing made writing easy for everyone：與 found it hard 相反。
Standing during lessons had mixed effects for the class：mixed effects 同時涵蓋清醒與書寫困難。
Some students felt awake：漏掉 others 的困難。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「涵蓋全文但不加入未被原文支持的人、時間、因果或普遍結論」可推出 Standing during lessons had mixed effects for the class；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Standing during lessons had mixed effects for the class 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
